case.title: SOC-LAB-INC-0001 - Repeated failed logins from synthetic source
case.description:
## Source
Synthetic Wazuh validation event; no real user or external host.

## Evidence
Five failed SSH logins for nonexistent user `phase6_missing_user` from TEST-NET-2 address `198.51.100.44`.

## Automated enrichment
Local MISP match: lab-created synthetic IP; reputation suspicious-in-lab; confidence 70.

## Analyst notes
Confirm the endpoint, time window, source ownership, and successful logins before recommending containment.

## Recommended remediation
If activity is confirmed unauthorized, propose a temporary lab-only source block and credential review. No action is executed automatically.

## Approval history
Pending analyst decision.

## Closure reason
Not closed; validation and lessons learned are required before closure.
